title: The Tortoise and the Hare
summary: A fast hare and a slow tortoise have a race.

source.author: Aesop
source.note: Retold from the plot of the fable in new A1 English by Lexkite; no sentences copied from any translation.

license: Adaptation CC BY 4.0 Lexkite; original fable in the public domain

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: a green tortoise and a brown hare at the start of a race on a sunny road with hills, no text

chapters.title: The Big Race
sentences: A hare is very fast.
He runs and jumps all day.
He laughs at a slow tortoise.
"You are so slow," says the hare.
The tortoise is not angry.
"Let us have a race," he says.
The hare laughs again.
"I will win easily," he says.
A fox shows the road to the hill.
The race starts, and the hare runs fast.

quiz.explain: The story says the hare is very fast.

quiz.q: What does the tortoise ask for?
quiz.explain: The tortoise says, "Let us have a race."

options: He thinks he will win easily.
quiz.explain: He says he will win easily because he is fast.

chapters.title: Slow and Steady
sentences: The hare is far from the tortoise.
He sees a big tree and stops.
"I have time," he thinks.
He sits down and sleeps.
The tortoise walks and walks.
He does not stop for a rest.
He passes the sleeping hare.
The hare wakes up at last.
He runs fast, but it is too late.
The tortoise is at the end of the road.
Slow and steady wins the race.

quiz.explain: He thinks he has time, so he sits down and sleeps.

quiz.q: Does the tortoise stop for a rest?
quiz.explain: The tortoise walks and does not stop for a rest.
The tortoise reaches the end of the road first.
